$comment: The source of sf-button's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/button (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

height.summary: The control height (owner decision C27), separate from size: size sets the text, the icons and the inner scale, height picks the control height from the size's tightness steps of the adaptive-sizing contract -- low, default, high, highest, the size's usual step and its neighbours on the UI height ladder. Desktop 1/3 24/28/32/40, 1/2 28/32/40/48, 1 32/40/48/56, 2 40/48/56/68, 3 48/56/68/80; phone 1/3 20/24/28/36, 1/2 24/28/36/44, 1 28/36/44/52, 2 36/44/52/64, 3 44/52/64/76. The side padding grows with the height by half of what the height adds, so the gap from the end to the icon stays the same. A compact region (data-sf-density) shifts the steps one down and height picks the neighbour there. A value outside the list reads as default, with one console warning.

appearance.summary: How the button looks: default (filled), tonal, outline, ghost (no fill or edge until hovered; rule C15) or surface (a faint fill on the neutral alpha ramp and a border). link is ghost's former name; a link is made by href, not by the look.

scheme.summary: Which colour family the control takes. on-surface-variant is the on-surface family one step quieter: the fill and the edge of on-surface, the label and the icons in --sf-on-surface-variant (a search trigger that reads like a field). With appearance surface on-surface-variant is retired (1.11.0, as on the icon buttons, C15): it draws as on-surface until 2027-01-01 and warns once. What the control is about is the status axis; a status set there wins over this.

status.summary: What the control is about (rule C13): danger, a control that deletes, discards or cannot be undone. It paints with the error roles -- the red of an error -- and behaves exactly like a primary control. error is its former name on a control.

text-position.summary: How the label aligns inside a button wider than its content: start, center or end (the text-align utility on the label).

text.summary: Visible button text when no text slot is provided.

segment.summary: The button's place in a joined group: start, middle or end squares the corners it shares with its neighbours; empty: a standalone button.

icon-position.summary: Placement for the single icon shortcut.

spacing.summary: Deprecated (decision C27, until 2027-01-01): the side padding only -- compact, normal, comfortable or spacious -- at the same height. It keeps working as before with a console warning and is not turned into height; write height for a lower or higher button.

full-width.summary: The control fills its container, as sf-segmented's full-width does, and its content stays in the middle; without it the button is as wide as its content (owner decision C36). The height does not change.

loading.summary: Loading state: the spinner at the icon's size in place of the start icon (else the end icon); without an icon it lies over the label, which keeps its place, so the width does not change. The spinner takes the page's look (data-sf-spinner) and the label's ink. The inner button is unavailable while it loads but keeps its scheme colour (owner decision C36); a button that is also disabled wears the disabled look.

form.summary: The id of the form the inner button submits or resets, as a native button's form attribute: a button outside the form (a wizard's footer) submits it. Not written on a link.

name.summary: The name the inner button submits its value under, as a native button's name.

value.summary: The value the inner button submits under name when it is the submitter (next, skip); for a cycle, the current item's value, which a press moves to the next one.

href.summary: An address: the button draws a link (an <a href>) with the button's look; role link, Enter and the browser's link keys follow it. A relative address, a fragment, http(s), mailto or tel; any other scheme draws a button. native-type, expanded and pressed do not apply; disabled or loading, the link has no href and says aria-disabled.

target.summary: Where a link (href) opens, as an <a target>: _blank opens a new tab. Not written on a button.

rel.summary: The link's relation, as an <a rel>. A link that opens in a new tab (target _blank) with no rel says noopener noreferrer, so the new page cannot reach this one. Not written on a button.

shortcut.summary: A key combination drawn at the end of the button as the kbd component's soft caps in the label's ink: words joined by +, e.g. mod+k (⌘K on a Mac, Ctrl K elsewhere), shift+mod+p (⇧⌘P, Ctrl Shift P), shift+/, / or escape. mod is Cmd on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere. The only input: a page never styles the keys. Also written as aria-keyshortcuts on the inner button. Empty: no keys

shortcut-listen.summary: The button listens to its shortcut on the page and is pressed by it, as by a click. A combination without mod, ctrl, alt or meta is not heard while focus is in an editable field

expanded.summary: Whether the panel this button opens is open: aria-expanded on the inner button; absent says nothing

pressed.summary: Whether this toggle button is on: aria-pressed on the inner button and the pressed look -- the primary container fill, its ink, no visible edge and the icon filled (rule C12); pressed="false" says off; absent, the button is not a toggle and nothing is said

text-pressed.summary: The label while the toggle is on, for a toggle whose label changes («В избранное» → «В избранном»). Set, the label says the state and aria-pressed is not written; the pressed look still follows pressed. Empty: the label stays the same and aria-pressed says the state

lang.summary: The language the label is written in (BCP 47).

pressed.summary: Draws this item with the pressed look (the «on» values of repeat); no aria-pressed is said.

cycle.x-shape: ui-source src/smart/helpers/cycle.js cycleItems: the attribute takes JSON or value::label::flags|… (flags icon=<name>, pressed), the property a list; the items are shaped like sf-segmented's items
cycle.summary: One button, several values (rule D11d): the items {value, label, icon, pressed?} a press steps through, wrapping at the end. value is the current item. The name and the icon say the current value («Скорость: 1,5×»), the tooltip says the current and the next, and a polite live region says the new value after a press; change {previous, value, item} follows. Not a toggle: pressed and text-pressed are ignored beside it, with one console warning.

theme-cycle.summary: A ready theme switch over SF.Loader's theme (the contract of sf-segmented's theme-switch: themePreference, setTheme, sf-theme-change). Present and empty: three values, «as the system», light and dark, in the owner's order -- first the theme opposite to the visible one, then the other, then «as the system» (rule D11d); "light dark": two values, every press flips the visible theme. The icons are contrast, light_mode and dark_mode; the words are the page language's («Тема: светлая. Нажмите — тёмная»). cycle is ignored beside it.

press.summary: A press: a click, Enter or Space on the inner button or link, or the shortcut-listen key; the detail is an empty object. Not sent by click() on the host, nor by a disabled or loading button.

item.summary: The item now current: {value, label, icon, lang, pressed}.

change.summary: A cycle (cycle or theme-cycle) moved to its next value after a person's press; dispatched on the host, bubbles and is composed, after press on sf-button. A theme cycle sends it after SF.Loader.setTheme has drawn the theme. Not sent by a button that is not a cycle.

relations.name: spinner
$comment: The spinner a loading button shows: its slot is drawn by the button sheet,
the motion by the spinner's, fetched after the page is ready.

relations.name: kbd
$comment: The keys of a shortcut are the kbd component's (soft caps inside a button):
fetched with the button, so the first paint draws them as they stay.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-button for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
the legacy axis name; the shim maps the attribute and the property
rows.summary: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: journal attribute-icon-left-right-to-start-end; icon-start wins when both are given
journal attribute-icon-left-right-to-start-end; icon-end wins when both are given
journal attribute-tightness-to-spacing; its words are spacing's value aliases below, spacing wins when both are given
journal value-button-link-to-ghost (rule C15): ghost is the name, link its former one; the earlier ghost-to-link record stays in the journal
journal value-control-status-error-to-danger (rule C13): a control's destructive status is danger; messages keep error
journal value-control-status-error-to-danger (rule C13); critical was an older word for the same
the physical name the template read as start
the physical name the template read as end

x-summary: A native button with Framework presentation: size, appearance, colour role or status, optional start and end icons, height and radius. loading sets aria-busy and disables it against repeated activation.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
x-decisions: a11y-role: button, the native <button> the template draws (the host is display:contents and takes no role). The name is the text (the setting, a text child or the text slot), else the host's aria-label, which the base passes to the native button (§3.1, §4.8).
key-effects: Tab reach. Enter and Space are the native button's own activation, not an effect of the closed list; they send press like a click, and probe.json drives Enter (gate 16).

press: the event the stands wrote as the 1.3.x target (x-target), sf-button-press with an empty detail, sent once per activation of the native button (a click, Enter, Space) and never while it is disabled or loading. The native click still bubbles as before; press is what a rule hears as <role>.press (§8, §9).

expanded: an optional boolean the stands added (x-target): present, it writes aria-expanded on the native button; absent, nothing is said. A page that wrote aria-expanded on the host keeps it: the host forwards it as before.

legacy names: type -> appearance, icon-left -> icon-start, icon-right -> icon-end and tightness -> spacing leave the settings and are dated setting aliases (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01; journal attribute-icon-left-right-to-start-end, attribute-tightness-to-spacing). The legacy values are dated value aliases: appearance ghost -> link (journal value-button-ghost-to-link), status danger and critical -> error (value-status-danger-critical-to-error), spacing low/high/highest -> compact/comfortable/spacious (tightness's words), icon-position left/right -> start/end.

icon-start and icon-end keep their own getters: an attribute written empty means «no icon here» and suppresses the icon shortcut, an absent one lets it through (null and "" differ), which a generated string setting cannot say.
aria-label is a host attribute, never a setting (§3.1); the template reads it from the host.

template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift). The host stays display:contents: geometry lives on > button.

examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (Продолжить, default primary) plus tonal, outline, link and surface, the error status, icons at the start and the end, an icon-only button with aria-label, loading, disabled and the sizes.
css-variables: the seven public variables of src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json the class sheet already reads (§6).

folder: buttons takes the tag's name, button (§3, §21, §16 item 16); the loader bundle is cl-button, cl-buttons is a Loader forward (src/core/contracts/smart-rule-forwards.v1.json) and smart/buttons/js/buttons.js a forwarding script until 2026-12-01 (change journal path-smart-buttons-to-button). The registry id follows the folder: smart.button (smart.buttons is its dated alias in the same record).
version 1.1.0: renamed members behind dated aliases and two added members (press, expanded) are a minor (§4.10, §16.20).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.1.4: a text attribute, even an empty one, is the label: emptying it empties the button instead of falling back to a text-child label (simai.main, a toolbar clearing its labels on a narrow screen, 2026-10-28).

version 1.2.0: a minor (§4.10): the settings shortcut and shortcut-listen and the scheme value on-surface-variant are added. shortcut draws the combination at the end of the button as kbd keys (one <kbd class="sf-kbd--group"> holding a <kbd> per key, aria-hidden, the native button's aria-keyshortcuts says it), muted (--sf-on-surface-variant), with the label taking the free room (flex 1) so text-position start reads like a field. The key box is the kbd sheet's (its variables, read with the same values as fallbacks, so the first paint holds before the lazily fetched kbd sheet). shortcut-listen presses the native button (a click, so sf-button-press follows) on the combination; a combination without a modifier is not heard in an editable field, and a disabled or loading button is never pressed. on-surface-variant: the search trigger of the Docara prototypes (search-and-settings.html) wanted the on-surface family with a quieter label; the template writes both scheme classes, sf-button--on-surface and sf-button--on-surface-variant, so every on-surface rule (fill, edge, type) holds and one rule moves the label and the icon to --sf-on-surface-variant.

version 1.3.0: a minor (§4.10): the setting pressed is added (stage 1 of the component sets, duplication audit A-10). Present, the native button carries aria-pressed ("true" or "false") and, while on, the class sheet's active state, the selected look the buttons component documents for a real two-state button; absent, the button is not a toggle and nothing is said. A page that wrote aria-pressed on the host keeps it: the host forwards it as before.

version 1.4.0: a minor (§4.10): the setting href is added (visual parity of the one block editor, 2026-11-04: a button that is a link). Set, the template draws <a href> with the same classes as the native button, so the class sheet gives it the button's look; its role is link and the browser follows it (Enter, the context menu, a new tab), sf-button-press still fires on a click. accessibility.role stays button for the element without href. A relative address, a fragment, http(s), mailto and tel are taken; any other scheme (javascript:, data:) is refused and the button draws as a button. Disabled or loading, the link loses its href (not reached by Tab, not followed) and says role link and aria-disabled true. native-type, expanded and pressed are a button's words and are not written on a link.

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-07): a cap of one character is a square key -- each key carries sf-button-shortcut-key--square when its cap is one character, and the sf-button-shortcut-key--chars-N classes are gone: a modifier no longer keeps the box of its widest platform word, so ⇧ and ⌘ stand as wide as P (docs review R010). The keys on a default or tonal button take the button's own ink (component.buttons 1.3.0, R009). Settings, values and events unchanged.

version 1.5.0: a minor (§4.10): the settings form, name and value are added (sf-wizard, owner decision 2026-11-06, ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-06-sf-wizard.md): the native button carries them as a native button does, so a button outside a form submits it (form) and the server reads which button sent it (name, value) -- a wizard's footer posts the step's form with next or skip and adds no hidden field. Before, a host attribute of these names reached the native button only as an undeclared forwarded attribute. They are a button's words: a link (href) does not carry them.

version 1.5.1 (2026-11-07): the reference wording (docs review R022): press says what sends it, checked in a browser on the built bytes -- a click, Enter or Space on the inner button or link, the shortcut-listen key; the detail is an empty object; not click() on the host, not a disabled or loading button (a click() on the inner button does send it). size, disabled and loading read plainly; the control is the inner button, the docs' term, not the native one. element.dataAttributes no longer returns the style gate's sfStyleReady / sfStylePending (core.runtime 1.32.2). scheme secondary in the outline, surface and link appearances is drawn (component.buttons 1.4.0, owner decision 2026-11-07, variant A): the on-surface button's edge, fill, padding, height and states with the label and the icons in --sf-secondary; before, those three had no rule -- about 32px at size 1, no padding, the browser's text colour. One height per size at every density (component.buttons 1.4.0). Settings, values and events unchanged.

version 1.6.0 (2026-11-07): a minor (§4.10): the pressed look and the setting text-pressed (owner decision 2026-11-07, docs review R028, rule C12). A toggle that is on wears sf-button--pressed instead of the active class: the primary container fill (--sf-primary-container), no visible edge (the border keeps its width, so the height of the size does not move, and is transparent over the fill), the label and the icons in --sf-on-primary-container, and the icons filled (FILL 1) -- two cues, not colour alone, the same in both themes. Hover and press over it step the container (+4, +8 of the fill family); focus draws the ring; disabled wears the disabled look and keeps the filled icon. Public variables --sf-button-pressed-background-color and --sf-button-pressed-color colour the resting pressed look. text-pressed is the label while on, for a toggle whose label changes: the label then says the state and aria-pressed is not written (both at once read «В избранном, нажата»). A host's aria-pressed and the plain class sheet's [aria-pressed="true"] draw the same look.

version 1.6.1 (2026-11-07): a loading button's spinner draws its ring inside the icon's live area (docs review R027, owner decision C11; component.spinner 1.1.0): 20 of the 24 units, as the Material Symbol beside it, in the same icon box, so nothing around it moves; the first-paint snapshots are retaken. The settings are unchanged.

version 1.6.2 (2026-11-08): the keys a person presses are listed as the icon button lists them (msg-c84f2727): Tab reaches the button, Enter and Space press it -- the generated reference showed Tab alone; a link (href) is followed by Enter, as the href setting says. The reference describes the current button only (docs review rules D02, D03): the appearance words no longer name the former ghost, which the change journal and the alias table carry, and pressed names the rule, not a sheet's version. Settings, values, events and the drawing are unchanged.

version 1.7.0 (2026-11-08): a minor (§4.10): the settings target and rel are added (Larena after sf-wizard, msg-12cd5ef6): a link (href) writes them on its <a> as they are given, so a button-looking link can open a new tab; target _blank with no rel says rel="noopener noreferrer" and the opened page cannot reach window.opener; a rel the page writes is kept. A button (no href) writes neither. Before, the host forwarded both as undeclared attributes onto whichever control it drew -- a <button target> too -- and a new tab kept the opener.

version 1.8.0 (2026-11-08): a minor (a look and markup; settings, values and events unchanged; owner decision 2026-11-07, docs review R030, rule C04, which supersedes the inverse caps of 1.4.1, R009/R010; component.kbd 1.1.0, component.buttons 1.6.0). The keys of a shortcut are the kbd component's: soft caps without an edge in the text face at medium weight, sized from the label -- 0.8125em letters, 1.6em high and at least as wide, 0.4em of room, 0.25em apart, --sf-radius--ui -- their ink the label's at 80 % and their fill that ink at 12 %, so they read on a filled button with no rule of the button's own (the per-scheme --sf-button-shortcut--ink map is gone). A key of one character stays a square. The markup: takes the label's ink and holds with a per key (sf-kbd--square on a one-character key; sf-button-shortcut-key--square is gone); off an Apple platform a + stands between the words (Ctrl+Shift+P), which the kbd sheet hides between caps. The kbd sheet is no longer a lazy relation: the button no longer draws the keys itself.

version 1.9.0 (2026-11-08): a minor (§4.10; docs review R031, R033, R039; owner rules C13, C15, D11d). status danger for a control that deletes or cannot be undone, error its dated alias (C13: messages keep error; one red, the error roles); critical now leads to danger too; the inner control carries sf-button--danger and sf-button--error, which the sheets and their consumers select. appearance ghost is the name of the look without a fill, link its dated alias (C15; href, not the look, makes a link); ghost is drawn by the link class the sheets already had. secondary keeps its own look (owner decision ui-5edc71bd6936). cycle (a list of {value, label, icon, pressed?}) and theme-cycle: one button, several values (D11d) -- an item with an icon shows it, one without shows its label as the text; the name says the current value, the title the current and the next, a polite live region the new value; change {previous, value, item} after press; a cycle's value is what the button submits. text-pressed and pressed are ignored beside a cycle, with one console warning.

version 1.10.0 (2026-11-09): a minor (§4.10; owner decision C27, prototype ui-control prototypes/button-leading.html). The setting height (low, default, high, highest; default default) picks the control height from the size's tightness steps -- the inner button's block padding is --sf-ui-<size>--space-y-tightness-<height>, its side padding the size's --sf-ui-<size>--space-x plus that step less the default one, so the end-to-icon gap does not change -- through the class sf-button--height-<height> of component.buttons 1.8.0 (none for default). The adaptive-sizing contract 1.6.0 moves desktop size 1/3 default from a4 to a6: a size 1/3 button stands 28 on desktop (24 before), low keeps 24; the phone is unchanged. spacing is deprecated (journal attribute-button-spacing-to-height, until 2027-01-01): it keeps drawing the side padding as before, says so once in the console and in SF.deprecations, and is not turned into a height. A height outside the list reads as default with one console warning. The public variables --sf-button-padding-block and --sf-button-padding-inline still win over both.

version 1.10.1 (2026-11-09): the keys of a shortcut read at 4.5:1 or more on every look (docs review R009; rule C04; buttons review 2026-11-09 on pair ui-b4a77681f0a7; component.kbd 1.2.1). Their ink is the label's own and their fill that ink at 8 %; the label's ink at 80 % on a 12 % fill fell to 4.03:1 on default primary (4.45:1 dark), 4.12:1 on default danger and 3.60:1 on the outline on-surface-variant search trigger. Markup, settings, values and events unchanged; tests/browser/button-shortcut-contrast.browser.mjs composes page, button, fill and ink for every appearance x scheme and danger, light and dark.

version 1.11.0 (2026-11-09): a minor (a retired value pair and a look fix; DEV, buttons review follow-up). appearance surface with scheme on-surface-variant is retired, as C15 did on the icon buttons: on the surface fill the quiet ink read 4.88:1 in dark and a shortcut key 4.38:1. The pair draws as surface + on-surface until 2027-01-01, is noted in SF.deprecations and warns once per page naming scheme="on-surface" (change journal value-button-surface-quiet-scheme); on-surface-variant stays with every other appearance and no other look changes colour. Danger reads as danger on surface too (C13; component.buttons 1.8.2): the label and the icon wear --sf-error, 5.6:1 light and 9:1 dark on the surface fill -- before they fell back to the plain ink. tests/browser/button-shortcut-contrast.browser.mjs (no exception left) and button-schemes.browser.mjs check both.

version 1.11.1 (2026-11-09): the keys of a shortcut are sized from the ladder (owner decision C38, which replaces C04's 0.8125em / 1.6em; component.kbd 1.3.0): a cap takes the text step one below the label's -- size 1/3 and 1/2 a cap 16 high with letters of 12, size 1 20/14, size 2 24/16, size 3 28/20 (on a phone 1/2 and 1 take 16; compact density follows through the tokens), --sf-space-1/4 of room and between caps. The kbd sheet reads the step from the button's size class; the button sets none of the key's variables. Ink and fill unchanged (4.5:1 or more on every look). Markup, settings, values and events unchanged.

version 1.11.2 (2026-11-10): a patch (R074). A cycle asks the Loader for every icon it can show when it is drawn (each item's icon, filled where the item is pressed; contrast, light_mode and dark_mode for theme-cycle), and a toggle (pressed present) for its icons in both forms: the names join the page's first icon request, so a press draws the next icon from the page's font instead of asking the service for a grown one (the icon stayed blank while it was built, up to ~30 s). Nothing drawn differently; settings, values and events unchanged.

version 1.12.0 (2026-11-10): a minor (§4.10; owner decision C36 after the buttons review on pair ui-b4a77681f0a7). The setting full-width (boolean, default false; the name and meaning of sf-segmented's full-width) makes the inner control fill its container with its content in the middle, through the class sf-button--full-width of component.buttons 1.9.0; root-class="w-full" keeps working. A loading button keeps its scheme colour -- the fill, the edge and the label of the resting button -- and its spinner takes the label's ink; it stays natively disabled and aria-busy, so a second press is still stopped. Before, loading wore the disabled look (a primary button drew the grey disabled fill). A button that is disabled and loading wears the disabled look: the inner control then also carries the class disabled. An icon-only sf-button keeps the button's side padding and is not square; the square one is sf-button-icon.
version 1.12.0 joins the unreleased 1.11.2 (R074) in one release (pair next, 2026-11-10); 1.11.2 never ships alone.

version 1.12.1 (2026-11-10, pair next integration): one number above every claim of this release, 1.11.2 (R074) and 1.12.0 (C36), which were built with different contents; nothing beyond the notes above changes. Settings, values, events and keys as the notes above say.

version 1.13.0 (2026-11-11, CB-01, decision C15): the button without a fill writes the class sf-button--ghost, the name of its appearance; sf-button--link, the class it wrote before, is written beside it until 2027-01-01 (journal class-button-link-to-ghost), so a page selector that reached it still does. Both classes are drawn by the same rules: computed styles identical in light and dark. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.13.0, also (2026-11-11, docs review R076, written as 1.12.2 on fix/theme-cycle-host): theme-cycle under a host that draws the theme itself (the Loader started with theme: false, as a Docara page and its examples are): the name and the icon say the theme the document draws (its theme-dark / theme-light class, else the system scheme) instead of the Loader's untouched light; a press that cannot move the theme says why once in the console (the host owns the theme, or SF.Loader is absent) and still stays put without change. Its shared helper src/smart/helpers/cycle.js changed (module.smart-helpers 1.5.0, unreleased). Nothing drawn differently where the Loader owns the theme; settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.13.1 (2026-11-13, a patch, defect BS-1 of ui-control research 2026-11-13-button-schemes, rule C13): a status other than danger -- success, warning, info or any other word -- was dropped without a sound and the scheme colour drawn. It still draws so, and the console says it once per page for each word (helpers/control-status.js, shared with sf-button-icon and sf-menu-context items; error and critical stay the former names of danger). Nothing drawn differently; settings, values, events and keys unchanged.
